author: Bernd
html: Nice article, thanks for sharing. I just wanted to give everybody a heads up on the latest development on the virtual thread “sychronized” pinning issue. The problem has been resolved, hence synchronized is not to be blamed for all your performance issues anymore 😉 – Dan Vega created a good video about it, see https://youtu.be/V4gsffMge7E?si=a_3jr7UItQrRAWIJ
